record.body:
## Evidence

Trace analysis of 142+ Cursor transcripts (1,406 CLI calls) via 3 Composer 2.5 Fast subagents on 2026-10-14; human selected keep_aa_cli + all 6 optimization categories. Prior continuity records archived at `.artifacts/archive/continuity-2026-10-14/` (finding rec-44782c88, commitment rec-acf38b28, observations rec-e014bbcc / rec-f2cb4b4d / rec-5d80e5fc / rec-0c9ebdf5).

## Consequence

Without these CLI changes, agents keep spending ~0.5–1 read per write on id/revision lookup, piping JSON through python/jq, and regenerating views with multiple commands; stale plugin hooks can clobber views.

## Follow-up

Implement under effort aa-cli-ergonomics after discuss/plan-phase. Do not treat the archive as live authority.

payload.basis: 2026-10-14 transcript analysis + human selection; archived continuity finding rec-44782c88
payload.claim: Keep adaptive-artifacts as the canonical extension/contract name while shipping a bin/aa CLI alias, and amend the CLI/runtime across six areas: (1) universal short type/view/bundle resolution, (2) optional --type with --id, --type+--subject targeting, default --expected-revision @current, --expected-revision on correct, (3) single-command view sync + exempt store views/ from validate_immutability, (4) list --where/--exact-subject/--order-by/--fields/--format, (5) get --full/--field/--body-only, -p/--set, --payload-file, apply --file, (6) worktree-aware store discovery + session_hooks stale-cache view guard.
payload.invalidated_when: The CLI surface is replaced by an incompatible CLI or human reverses the aa alias / 6-area scope.
